_comment: Rusty's helmet is an inverted stainless kitchen mixing bowl that had been a popcorn bowl — it is the single most-told fact about this robot, and it came off the scan flat white, which reads as painted plastic. Paint it as polished stainless instead. NOT metalness 1.0: a metal has no diffuse term, so with no environment map in this scene a fully metallic dome renders BLACK — which is why models.js SURFACE sits at 0.28 for every scanned part. 0.45 with a bright base and a low roughness is what actually reads as a mixing bowl here. Flat colour is right here, the scan's texture for it carries no detail worth keeping.
